status: Provisional modular art and placement-layout preview, not Unity integration
materials: Original packed Tripo textures; no new lighting on the wall
joining_rule: Exactly two intact end piers for one continuous straight run, repeated center mesh and cropped last center piece; no mesh or UV stretching

integer_footprint.interpretation: Confirmed: complete runs reserve 2 x N integer cells, N >= 2; odd lengths are supported
integer_footprint.note: Grid reservation is confirmed. Native art proportions are preserved; final Unity collision geometry is not yet implemented. One-cell internal spans are not independently placeable walls.

integer_end_rule: Reject fractional placement inputs. Stop exactly at the first blocked cell or integer map boundary. Reject the full run if fewer than two cells remain. Repeating middle mesh can be trimmed to the integer endpoint without stretching end piers.

tower_replacement.rule: Replace occupied middle-wall geometry, do not overlap meshes. Snap to any integer start cell. Protect the first and last cell occupied by the end piers. Reject overlapping existing tower slots.
tower_replacement.preview_asset: Original imported cannon tower; arrow/flame appearances not yet supplied
tower_replacement.scope: Blender placement-policy and art preview, not Unity runtime construction

per-section building damage, destruction and NavMesh carving
